raw_output: {"kind":"answer","urgent":true,"ask":null,"answer":{"cause":"Thick grey smoke with a strong burning smell from under the bonnet is a serious overheating, fluid leak or electrical problem that could turn into a fire.","confidence":"possible","alternatives":["Oil or coolant leaking onto the hot engine or exhaust","A burning electrical wire or a failing turbo"],"steps":["Call 112 now and tell them your car is smoking under the bonnet beside the road.","Switch off the engine and get everyone out on the side away from traffic, taking only your phone.","Move everyone at least 30 m away from the car, upwind, well off the road, and do not go back for belongings.","Do not open the bonnet, because fresh air can make a fire flare up.","Only if it is safe and you are well away from traffic, place the warning triangle behind the car. Skip this if there are flames.","Once the smoke has stopped and 112 has dealt with it, call roadside assistance for a tow. Do not drive the car again."],"escalate_if":["You see flames or the smoke gets thicker or darker","Anyone feels dizzy, short of breath or is hurt","You smell or see fuel leaking under the car","The smoke drifts across the road and blocks drivers' view"],"photo_observation":null,"extra_categories":["repair"]}}
